title: Named-model probe (test-only)
author: mewgenics-mods
description: Test-only overlay for the 3D phase M3 named models ("@Name"): data/models.gon.append declares NameBox (models/name-box.gltf, a magenta 0.6-tile glTF box) and the vanilla Rat refers to it with `graphics { model { file "@NameBox" scale 1.25 } }`, while the vanilla Pooter refers to an undeclared @NoSuchModel (one model-name-unknown line, the Pooter keeps its sprite). Load it with fw-3d (the base data/models.gon and the mesh shader): `mods: _modelnames, fw-3d`. Never for play.
